description: Every perpetual market on Hyperliquid in one call: mark, mid and oracle price, hourly and annualized funding, open interest, 24 h volume and change, max leverage and lot size, sorted by volume. With coin you get that market plus the top five levels of its order book. Also reports the builder fee that orders placed through /hyperliquid/prepare carry. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).
